intermediate: The input-dependent four-entry panel occupancy vector, indexed by section 0,1,2,3.
step_a: Count the nonzero cells separately in each of the four input panels.
step_b: Choose the densest or sparsest panel using the occupancy vector and tie order 2,3,0,1; construct the fixed-direction cyclic scan from that selected panel and overlay aligned cells.
why_b_depends_on_a: The selected starting panel changes with counts elsewhere in the input, even when the values at a particular aligned output position are unchanged. The cyclic overlay order therefore cannot be chosen before the occupancy vector is known.
